overall_goal: Drain and mash the boiled potatoes, then mix them with chicken, cheese, and flour in a saucepan.

goals.description: Transfer boiled potatoes to a bowl and drain the saucepan.
goals.rationale: The person prepares a bowl, scoops the boiled potatoes into it, and empties the excess water from the saucepan into the sink.
The person uses a potato masher and a fork to thoroughly mash and fluff the boiled potatoes in the bowl.

goals.description: Add shredded chicken to the saucepan.
goals.rationale: The person inspects the dried saucepan on the hob and empties the bowl of shredded chicken into it.

goals.description: Add grated cheese to the saucepan.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the scale with grated cheese and adds the cheese to the saucepan on the hob.

goals.description: Add mashed potatoes and flour to the saucepan and mix all ingredients.
goals.rationale: The person scoops the mashed potatoes and pours flour into the saucepan, then stirs everything together.
